title: Effort
measures: How much real work the student put into the sprint: commits that carry code, net code lines, files changed and tasks finished. Counted on real source lines only (comments, blank lines, formatting-only changes, generated and documentation files do not count).
inputs: commits with clean line statistics (code / comment / blank / format-only)
computation: Ridge model on four log features (E_CC commits, E_LOC_net_capped lines, E_FC files, E_CT tasks done) after a guard: a commit counts only as far as it carries lines (one per 100 lines), at most 5 files are credited per commit, zero commits give zero. Score 0-1.
output_scale: 0 = no real work, about 0.5 = a typical active student, 1 = heavy contribution.
gates: Provisional scores need at least 1 day of the sprint; before that: not available.
validation: 144 real student-sprints, student-disjoint 5-fold CV against assistant-written rubric ratings: MAE 0.064 (commit-count baseline 0.087), Pearson 0.95. Library dumps and micro-commit spam stay below 0.35 by test. Labels are not human ratings.
limits: Language coverage follows file extensions; unusual languages count as configuration and give no effort.
A student who commits through a shared account or whose e-mail is not mapped appears to have done nothing.
The score measures volume of real change, not quality.

warnings.provisional: Counts are to date; the score will normally rise.
warnings.feature .* missing: A feature could not be computed and the training median was used; look at the evidence.
warnings.no activity: The student has no counted commit; the score is 0 by rule.

typical_problems.symptom: score near 0 but the student is known to have worked
typical_problems.likely_cause: commits authored under an e-mail or name that is not mapped to the student

typical_problems.symptom: very high score from one huge commit
typical_problems.likely_cause: imported or generated files counted as code

typical_problems.symptom: score far below the student's earlier sprints without a visible reason
typical_problems.likely_cause: sprint window or branch missing from the evidence
